scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:api
scripts.lint: npm --workspace client run lint && npm --workspace server run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace client run typecheck && npm --workspace server run typecheck
scripts.db:types: supabase gen types typescript --project-id $SUPABASE_PROJECT_ID --schema public > client/src/types/database.ts
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:push && npm run db:types
